task.title: Checking data replication in backend buckets
task.shortdesc: To ensure that your Red Hat Quay data is properly replicated in all backend buckets, you can use the aws CLI to list objects in the bucket. Run aws s3 ls with --recursive, --human-readable, and --summarize to verify replication.

ul.li: You have installed the aws CLI.
